task_summary: Executed end-to-end rendering speed, anticipatory route chunking, HTTP 206 byte-range PDF streaming, and zero-downtime rolling deployment optimizations across 6 phases: injected inline blocking theme script in client/index.html to eliminate dark-mode white flash (FOWT); implemented anticipatory route prefetching on hover via client/src/lib/routePrefetch.js with idle-callback priority; optimized 60 FPS scrolling and DOM layout containment with content-visibility and contain-intrinsic-size auto heights; enabled HTTP 206 partial content byte-range streaming for PDF manuscripts; applied .lean({ virtuals: true, getters: true }) to read queries; and implemented graceful HTTP server draining and configured stop_grace_period: 20s in Docker Compose. Verified with 11/11 client tests, 15/15 server tests, production build in 12.37s, 0 route mismatches (204/182), 60/60 agentic validation checks, and clean governance pipeline.

Phase 2: Anticipatory Route Chunking & Link Hover Prefetching
Phase 3: 60 FPS Scrolling & DOM Layout Virtualization
Phase 4: Manuscript Rendering & HTTP 206 Byte-Range Streaming
Phase 5: Read-Heavy REST Query Optimization via Lean Virtuals
Phase 6: Availability Guarantee & Zero-Downtime Rolling Deployment
